faq.question: How fast will I receive my product?
faq.answer: Delivery time depends on the product type, package availability, payment confirmation, and the accuracy of the submitted details. Each product card shows an estimated delivery time.

faq.question: Do you offer refunds?
faq.answer: Refund rules are clearly defined by product type. Some digital products may not be refundable after successful processing. The policy is visible before checkout.

faq.question: Is QuickSub affiliated with the brands listed?
faq.answer: QuickSub is an independent digital product and service provider. Product names, logos, and trademarks belong to their respective owners. QuickSub is not affiliated with or endorsed by those brands unless stated officially.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing or using QuickSub, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Services
sections.body: QuickSub provides digital subscription access, gaming top-ups, and AI tool subscriptions. Product availability, pricing, and delivery times may change without prior notice.

sections.heading: 3. Orders and Payment
sections.body: All orders are subject to payment verification. You must provide accurate account or game details. QuickSub reserves the right to cancel orders with incorrect or incomplete information.

sections.heading: 4. Delivery
sections.body: Delivery times shown on product cards are estimates. Most orders are processed within the stated window after payment confirmation. Delays may occur during high demand or verification checks.

sections.heading: 5. Account Responsibility
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your accounts and for all activity under your order details. QuickSub is not liable for issues caused by incorrect information you provide.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: QuickSub is an independent reseller and is not affiliated with the brands listed unless stated otherwise. We are not responsible for third-party service outages, policy changes, or account restrictions imposed by original providers.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide when ordering (name, contact details, game IDs, payment references) and technical data such as browser type and page visits.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Data
sections.body: Your data is used to process orders, provide customer support, send order updates, and improve our services. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: AI Support Chat
sections.body: When you send a support chat message, its text and recent conversation context are sent to Google Gemini to generate a reply. Do not share passwords, OTPs, payment PINs or card details. QuickSub keeps recent chat context temporarily in server memory, expires it after 30 minutes of inactivity, and removes expired sessions on subsequent chat requests. AI replies can be inaccurate; human support confirms package prices and handles payments and orders. Provider processing is subject to Google Gemini data policies.

sections.heading: Data Storage
sections.body: Order-related data is stored securely and retained only as long as needed for support, legal compliance, and dispute resolution.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting our support team. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy-related inquiries, reach us via WhatsApp or email listed in the Contact section.

sections.heading: General Policy
sections.body: Due to the digital nature of our products, refunds are generally not available once an order has been successfully delivered or activated.

sections.heading: Eligible Refund Cases
sections.body: Refunds may be considered if: the order was not delivered within the promised timeframe, the wrong product was delivered, or a duplicate charge occurred.

sections.heading: Non-Refundable Cases
sections.body: Refunds are not provided for: incorrect player IDs or account details submitted by the customer, account bans by game or service providers, or change of mind after successful delivery.

sections.heading: How to Request
sections.body: Contact support within 48 hours of your order with your order ID and payment proof. Each case is reviewed individually.

sections.heading: Delivery Method
sections.body: All products are delivered digitally. Subscriptions are activated on your account or shared via secure credentials. Gaming top-ups are credited directly to your game account.

sections.heading: Delivery Times
sections.body: Estimated delivery times are shown on each product card. Most orders complete within 15 minutes to 2 hours depending on product type and verification requirements.

sections.heading: Order Tracking
sections.body: Use the Track Order feature in the header with your order ID to check status: Pending, Processing, or Delivered.

sections.heading: Failed Deliveries
sections.body: If delivery fails due to incorrect details, our team will contact you to verify information. Repeated failed attempts may result in order cancellation.

sections.heading: Brand Independence
sections.body: QuickSub is an independent digital product provider. All product names, logos, and trademarks belong to their respective owners. QuickSub is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Netflix, Spotify, PUBG, OpenAI, or any other listed brand unless officially stated.

sections.heading: Service Availability
sections.body: We do not guarantee uninterrupted access to third-party services. Outages, regional restrictions, and policy changes by original providers are outside our control.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: Prices displayed are starting prices in BDT and may vary by package duration or quantity. Final pricing is confirmed at the time of order.

sections.heading: What We Use
sections.body: QuickSub uses browser local storage to remember your saved products (favorites) and cookie consent preference. We do not use third-party advertising or analytics tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Managing Preferences
sections.body: You can clear local storage through your browser settings at any time. This will reset your saved products and cookie consent choice.

sections.heading: Newsletter
sections.body: If you subscribe to our newsletter, your email is stored securely via Supabase and used only for promotional updates. You can unsubscribe at any time.

operations.ordering: Open product details to select an available exact-price package and place an order. Save the receipt ID and private access code. Payment references are reviewed manually. If no packages are available, contact WhatsApp support.
operations.limitations: The support assistant cannot access private orders or confirm payment. Direct customers to Track Order with their saved receipt ID and private access code; never ask them to paste the access code into AI chat. Fulfillment and refunds are handled by staff, not automatically.
